P4 LB Model No FE
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 0. LOAD LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(randomForest)

# ============================================================
# 1. FILTER DATASET (P4 ONLY, ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================
dt_data <- mlb_all %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4")

# ============================================================
# 1.5 CONVERT PERCENTAGE COLUMNS TO NUMERIC (CRITICAL)
# ============================================================
percent_cols <- c(
  "Pass.Rush.Win.Percentage",
  "Pass.Rush.Pressure.Percentage",
  "Negative.Rush.Grade.Percentage",
  "Positive.Rush.Grade.Percentage",
  "Completion.Percentage.Allowed",
  "Successful.Plays.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays",
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage",
  "X15..Yards.Allowed.Percentage",
  "Percentage.of.Open.Targets",
  "Percentage.of.First.Down.or.Touchdown.Allowed",
  "Interceptions.per.Target.Coverage.Percentage",
  "Forced.Incompletion.Percentage"
)

dt_data <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    any_of(percent_cols),
    ~ as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .)) / 100
  ))


# ============================================================
# 2. DROP COVERAGE + UNWANTED FEATURES
# ============================================================
dt_data <- dt_data %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    # Identifiers
    "Player.Id", "Jersey.Number", "Player.College.GSIS",

    # Volume/context (per your request)
    "Pass.Rush.Plays",
    "Games.Won",
    "Key.Plays",
    "Defensive.Plays",
    "Negative.Plays",
    "Rush.Plays",
    "Run.Plays",
    "Coverage.Plays"
  )))

# ============================================================
# 3. PLAYER INFO (IDENTIFIERS ONLY)
# ============================================================
player_info <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(Row_ID, Name, Team, Season, Conference, All_Con)


# ============================================================
# 4. MODEL MATRIX (NUMERIC ONLY, KEEP ALL PLAYERS)
# ============================================================
df_model <- dt_data %>%
  mutate(Row_ID = row_number()) %>%
  select(
    Row_ID,
    All_Con,
    where(is.numeric),
    -Season
  ) %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Median imputation (CRITICAL FIX)
df_model <- df_model %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = -c(Row_ID, All_Con),
    .fns  = ~ ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)
  ))


# ============================================================
# 5. REMOVE NEAR-ZERO VARIANCE
# ============================================================
predictors <- df_model %>% select(-Row_ID, -All_Con)

nzv <- nearZeroVar(predictors, saveMetrics = TRUE)
predictors <- predictors[, !nzv$nzv, drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 6. REMOVE HIGHLY CORRELATED FEATURES
# ============================================================
cor_mat <- cor(predictors)
high_cor <- findCorrelation(cor_mat, cutoff = 0.70)

predictors <- predictors[, -high_cor, drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# 7. FINAL MODEL DATAFRAME
# ============================================================
df_final <- predictors %>%
  mutate(
    All_Con = df_model$All_Con,
    Row_ID  = df_model$Row_ID
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. TRAIN / TEST SPLIT (ALL YEARS)
# ============================================================
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df_final$All_Con, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train_data <- df_final[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df_final[-train_idx, ]

x_cols <- setdiff(names(train_data), c("All_Con", "Row_ID"))

# ============================================================
# 9. TRAIN RANDOM FOREST
# ============================================================
rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = train_data[, x_cols],
  y = as.factor(train_data$All_Con),
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(length(x_cols))),
  importance = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 10. TEST SET PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
test_probs <- predict(rf_model, test_data[, x_cols], type = "prob")
test_preds <- predict(rf_model, test_data[, x_cols])

test_data$Composite_Score <- test_probs[, 2]

# ============================================================
# 11. PLAYER GRADES
# ============================================================
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 12. MERGE PLAYER INFO
# ============================================================
test_with_names <- test_data %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID")

# ============================================================
# 13. FEATURE IMPORTANCE TABLE
# ============================================================
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = rownames(importance(rf_model)),
  Importance = importance(rf_model)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

print(importance_df)
View(importance_df)

# ============================================================
# 14. VISUALIZATIONS
# ============================================================
ggplot(test_data, aes(Player_Grade)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkgreen") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Player Grade Distribution")

ggplot(test_data, aes(Composite_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, fill = "darkorange", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Composite Score Distribution")

roc_obj <- roc(test_data$All_Con, test_data$Composite_Score)
#plot(roc_obj, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve")
#auc(roc_obj)

# ============================================================
# 15. METRICS (YOUR EXACT FORMAT)
# ============================================================
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(test_preds, as.factor(test_data$All_Con))

calc_metrics <- function(cm) {
  TP <- cm$table[2, 2]
  TN <- cm$table[1, 1]
  FP <- cm$table[1, 2]
  FN <- cm$table[2, 1]

  accuracy <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) NA else TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity <- if ((TN + FP) == 0) NA else TN / (TN + FP)
  balanced_accuracy <- mean(c(recall, specificity))
  f1_score <- if ((precision + recall) == 0) NA else 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

  tibble(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(accuracy),
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    Specificity = specificity,
    Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy,
    F1_Score = f1_score
  )
}

calc_metrics(conf_matrix)

# ============================================================
# 16. FULL DATASET PREDICTIONS (2021–2025)
# ============================================================
full_probs <- predict(rf_model, df_final[, x_cols], type = "prob")

df_final$Composite_Score <- full_probs[, 2]

full_data <- df_final %>%
  left_join(player_info, by = "Row_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.90) ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.75) ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.50) ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= quantile(Composite_Score, 0.25) ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 17. YEAR FILTER (CHANGE THIS LINE ONLY)
# ============================================================
YEAR_TO_VIEW <- 2025

players_by_year <- full_data %>%
  filter(Season == YEAR_TO_VIEW) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score)) %>%
  select(Name, Team, Season, Composite_Score, Player_Grade)

print(players_by_year)
View(players_by_year)

# ============================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE BAR PLOT
# ============================================================
ggplot(importance_df, aes(
  x = reorder(Feature, Importance),
  y = Importance
)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Feature Importance",
    subtitle = "Mean Decrease in Gini",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Importance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

colnames(lb_week1_2024)
```

P4 Week 1
```{r}
# --- P4 Week 1 Linebacker Grading ---

# ---------------- 1) Prep week1 like training --------------------------
lb_week1_proc <- lb_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Conference_Level == "P4", Team != "ALABAMA") %>%
  mutate(
    Defensive.Snaps = ifelse(is.na(Defensive.Snaps), 1, Defensive.Snaps),
    Row_ID = row_number()
  )

# --- Comprehensive features for LB (no "plays" stats) ---
model_features_lb <- c(
  # ORIGINAL IMPORTANCE PLOT FEATURES
  "Assist.Tackles.on.Run.Plays",
  "Run.Defense.Grade",
  "Pass.Rush.Grade",
  "Coverage.Grade",
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Run.Plays",
  "Average.Depth.of.Tackle",
  "Pursuit.Pressure",
  "Run.Tackle.for.Losss.or.No.Gain",
  "Pass.Rush.Productivity",
  "Passer.Rating.Allowed",
  "Average.Depth.of.Target.per.Coverage",
  "Yards.per.Reception.Allowed",
  "Receiving.Yards.Allowed.per.Snap",
  "Assist.on.Pass.Plays",
  "Unblocked.Pass.Rush",
  "Drops...Off.Targets.Receptions.Forced",
  "Sacks",
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Pass.Plays",
  "Beaten.Defender",
  "Plays.of.15..Yards.Allowed",
  "Hits",
  "Pass.Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain",
  "Lined.up.in.Press.Coverage",
  "Batted.Passes.at.the.Line",
  "Pass.Break.Up",
  "Forced.Fumble",
  "Interceptions",
  "Touchdowns.Allowed",
  "Fumble.Recovery",
  "Dropped.Int",
  
  # ADDITIONAL STATS (no "plays")
  "Total.Tackles",
  "Stops",
  "Assistant",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage",
  "Run.Stop",
  "Pass.Stop",
  "Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain",
  "Hurries",
  "Total.Pressures.Generated",
  "Defensive.Grades",
  "Assist.Tackles",
  "Negative.Plays",
  "Negative.Plays.",
  "Total.Negative.Plays",
  "Total.Positive.Plays",
  "Receptions.Allowed",
  "Completion.Percentage.Allowed",
  "Pass.Yards.Allowed",
  "First.Downs.Allowed",
  "Forced.Incompletions",
  "Sacks.per.Throwaway",
  "Open.Targets",
  "X15..Yards.Allowed.Percentage",
  "Percentage.of.Open.Targets",
  "Percentage.of.First.Down.or.Touchdown.Allowed",
  "Interceptions.per.Target.Coverage.Percentage",
  "Receiving.Yards.per.Coverage.Target",
  "Forced.Incompletion.Percentage",
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays",
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage",
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps",
  "NFL.Sacks",
  "First.Contact"
)

# --- LB Weights with adjustments ---
# Times 3: Assist.Tackles.on.Run.Plays, Run.Defense.Grade, Pass.Rush.Grade
# Times 1.5: Coverage.Grade, Missed.Tackles.on.Run.Plays, Average.Depth.of.Tackle, 
#            Pursuit.Pressure, Run.Tackle.for.Losss.or.No.Gain
feature_weights_lb <- c(
  # === TIMES 3 ===
  "Assist.Tackles.on.Run.Plays" = 96.850110,       # 32.283370 * 3
  "Run.Defense.Grade" = 73.670790,                 # 24.556930 * 3
  "Pass.Rush.Grade" = 63.178533,                   # 21.059511 * 3
  
  # === TIMES 1.5 ===
  "Coverage.Grade" = 30.000554,                    # 20.000369 * 1.5
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Run.Plays" = -28.607514,      # 19.071676 * 1.5 (Negative - lower is better)
  "Average.Depth.of.Tackle" = 27.588915,           # 18.392610 * 1.5
  "Pursuit.Pressure" = 27.458267,                  # 18.305511 * 1.5
  "Run.Tackle.for.Losss.or.No.Gain" = 27.197010,   # 18.131340 * 1.5
  
  # === ORIGINAL WEIGHTS ===
  "Pass.Rush.Productivity" = 17.835592,
  "Passer.Rating.Allowed" = -17.595331,            # Negative - lower is better
  "Average.Depth.of.Target.per.Coverage" = 17.052400,
  "Yards.per.Reception.Allowed" = -16.954144,      # Negative - lower is better
  "Receiving.Yards.Allowed.per.Snap" = -16.807595, # Negative - lower is better
  "Assist.on.Pass.Plays" = 15.507280,
  "Unblocked.Pass.Rush" = 14.955596,
  "Drops...Off.Targets.Receptions.Forced" = 14.575271,
  "Sacks" = 14.520552,
  "Missed.Tackles.on.Pass.Plays" = -13.474298,    # Negative - lower is better
  "Beaten.Defender" = -12.417880,                  # Negative - lower is better
  "Plays.of.15..Yards.Allowed" = -12.331710,       # Negative - lower is better
  "Hits" = 10.998942,
  "Pass.Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain" = 10.975451,
  "Lined.up.in.Press.Coverage" = 10.606474,
  "Batted.Passes.at.the.Line" = 7.623172,
  "Pass.Break.Up" = 7.362945,
  "Forced.Fumble" = 5.719763,
  "Interceptions" = 5.300287,
  "Touchdowns.Allowed" = -4.552274,                # Negative - lower is better
  "Fumble.Recovery" = 3.477924,
  "Dropped.Int" = 2.892739,
  
  # === ADDITIONAL STAT WEIGHTS ===
  "Total.Tackles" = 25,
  "Stops" = 30,
  "Assistant" = 20,
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage" = -18,                # Negative - lower is better
  "Run.Stop" = 22,
  "Pass.Stop" = 18,
  "Tackle.for.Loss.or.No.Gain" = 15,
  "Hurries" = 18,
  "Total.Pressures.Generated" = 20,
  "Defensive.Grades" = 45,
  "Assist.Tackles" = 15,
  "Negative.Plays" = -10,                          # Negative - lower is better
  "Negative.Plays." = -10,                         # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Negative.Plays" = -8,                     # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Positive.Plays" = 8,
  "Receptions.Allowed" = -8,                       # Negative - lower is better
  "Completion.Percentage.Allowed" = -6,            # Negative - lower is better
  "Pass.Yards.Allowed" = -6,                       # Negative - lower is better
  "First.Downs.Allowed" = -8,                      # Negative - lower is better
  "Forced.Incompletions" = 8,
  "Sacks.per.Throwaway" = 6,
  "Open.Targets" = -5,                             # Negative - lower is better
  "X15..Yards.Allowed.Percentage" = -5,            # Negative - lower is better
  "Percentage.of.Open.Targets" = -5,               # Negative - lower is better
  "Percentage.of.First.Down.or.Touchdown.Allowed" = -6,  # Negative - lower is better
  "Interceptions.per.Target.Coverage.Percentage" = 5,
  "Receiving.Yards.per.Coverage.Target" = -6,      # Negative - lower is better
  "Forced.Incompletion.Percentage" = 6,
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays" = -12,   # Negative - lower is better
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,          # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps" = 3,
  "NFL.Sacks" = 10,
  "First.Contact" = 8
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% names(lb_week1_proc)) {
    lb_week1_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week1_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
p4_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_full_stats)

# --- Display summary statistics ---

write.csv(p4_lb_full_stats, "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 1/P4/P4 LB Full Stats Week 1 2024.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

      v
    })
  )

    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week2_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
p4_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,

    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,            # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps" = 3,
  "NFL.Sacks" = 10,
  "First.Contact" = 8
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% names(lb_week3_proc)) {
    lb_week3_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week3_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
g5_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%

    Defensive.Grades,

    Pass.Rush.Grade,

    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)

write.csv(g5_lb_full_stats, "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 3/G5/G5 LB Full Stats Week 3 2024.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week4_proc %>%
```

```{r}
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week4_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
g5_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week5_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
g5_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,          # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps" = 3,
  "NFL.Sacks" = 10,
  "First.Contact" = 8
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% names(lb_week6_proc)) {
    lb_week6_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week6_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
p4_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(

    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_full_stats)

# --- Display summary statistics ---
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

      v
    })
  )

# For grades, we use median imputation

    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week7_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week7_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  "Forced.Incompletion.Percentage" = 6,
  "Missed.Tackle.Percentage.on.Run.Plays" = -12,     # Negative - lower is better
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,            # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps" = 3,
  "NFL.Sacks" = 10,
  "First.Contact" = 8
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% names(lb_week8_proc)) {
    lb_week8_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week8_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)

write.csv(g5_lb_full_stats, "/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Grade Sheet/Defense/Week 8/G5/G5 LB Full Stats Week 8 2024.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week9_proc %>%
```

```{r}
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week9_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
g5_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  }

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week10_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
g5_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,          # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps" = 3,
  "NFL.Sacks" = 10,
  "First.Contact" = 8
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% names(lb_week11_proc)) {
    lb_week11_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week11_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
p4_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(

    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_full_stats)

# --- Display summary statistics ---
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

      v
    })
  )

# For grades, we use median imputation

    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week12_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week12_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
```

```{r}
# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}
```

```{r}
# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
p4_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(p4_lb_full_stats)
```

```{r}
  "Pass.Missed.Tackles.Percentage" = -10,            # Negative - lower is better
  "Total.Tackle.Snaps" = 3,
  "NFL.Sacks" = 10,
  "First.Contact" = 8
)

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
```
