  if (!f %in% names(lb_week13_proc)) {
    lb_week13_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back

  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week13_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)

# --- G5 LB Weights with adjustments ---

# --- Ensure all features exist in LB data ---
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% names(lb_week14_proc)) {
    lb_week14_proc[[f]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# --- Apply the same processing as other positions ---
percent_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("%","", x)))
    return(ifelse(is.na(out), NA_real_, out/100))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Build numeric matrix - handle NAs properly
lb_input_all <- lb_week14_proc %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(model_features_lb), ~ {
      v <- percent_to_numeric(.x)
      v[is.infinite(v)] <- NA_real_
      v
    })
  )

# Impute missing values with 0 (for stats where NA means 0 or no data)
# For grades, we use median imputation
grade_features <- c("Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Coverage.Grade", "Defensive.Grades")
for (f in grade_features) {
  if (f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    median_val <- suppressWarnings(median(lb_input_all[[f]], na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.na(median_val)) median_val <- 0
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- median_val
  }
}

# For other features, impute with 0 (NA means no events)
for (f in model_features_lb) {
  if (!f %in% grade_features && f %in% names(lb_input_all)) {
    lb_input_all[[f]][is.na(lb_input_all[[f]])] <- 0
  }
}

# Calculate weighted composite score
calculate_weighted_score <- function(data, features, weights) {
  scores <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  total_weight <- sum(abs(weights))
  
  for (i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature <- features[i]
    weight <- weights[i]
    
    if (feature %in% names(data)) {
      # Normalize each feature to 0-1 scale
      if (sd(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        normalized_feature <- (data[[feature]] - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 
          (max(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE) - min(data[[feature]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        normalized_feature <- 0.5
      }
      
      # For negative weights, invert the score (lower raw value = higher score)
      if (weight < 0) {
        normalized_feature <- 1 - normalized_feature
      }
      
      scores <- scores + (normalized_feature * abs(weight))
    }
  }
  
  return(scores / total_weight)
}

lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- calculate_weighted_score(lb_input_all, model_features_lb, feature_weights_lb)

# --- Rescale Scores (0–100 + 2 decimals) like QB scores ---
if (length(unique(lb_input_all$Composite_Score)) > 1) {
  min_s <- min(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_s <- max(lb_input_all$Composite_Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  lb_input_all <- lb_input_all %>%
    mutate(
      Composite_Score = round(
        100 * ((Composite_Score - min_s) / (max_s - min_s)),
        2
      )
    )
} else {
  lb_input_all$Composite_Score <- 50
}

# Join scores back
lb_scored_all <- lb_week14_proc %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Composite_Score = lb_input_all$Composite_Score
  )

# --- Grade Assignment (Using same scale as QB) ---
lb_scored_all <- lb_scored_all %>%
  mutate(
    Player_Grade = case_when(
      Composite_Score >= 80.0 ~ "A",
      Composite_Score >= 60.0 ~ "B",
      Composite_Score >= 40.0 ~ "C",
      Composite_Score >= 20.0 ~ "D",
      TRUE ~ "F"
    )
  )

# --- Join scores + grades back ---
lb_combined_scored <- lb_week14_proc %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    lb_scored_all %>% select(row_id, Composite_Score, Player_Grade),
    by = "row_id"
  )

# --- LB Grade Sheet (like QB format) ---
g5_lb_grade_sheet <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name,
    Team,
    Defensive.Snaps,
    Composite_Score,
    Player_Grade
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_grade_sheet)

# --- LB Full stats view (ALL features used in the model, with key stats first) ---
g5_lb_full_stats <- lb_combined_scored %>%
  select(
    Name, 
    Team, 
    Defensive.Snaps, 
    Composite_Score, 
    Player_Grade,
    Defensive.Grades,
    Run.Defense.Grade,
    Pass.Rush.Grade,
    Total.Tackles,
    Assistant,
    Stops,
    all_of(setdiff(model_features_lb, c("Defensive.Grades", "Run.Defense.Grade", "Pass.Rush.Grade", "Total.Tackles", "Assistant", "Stops")))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Composite_Score))

View(g5_lb_full_stats)
